vc_checking.summary: Both current manual witnesses are semantically proofable with the annotation-approved cut predicates and already-proved case_lib lemmas. The entail witness splits the original complete DLL at prefix ++ removed_node :: suffix and exposes exactly the predecessor/successor boundary stores needed by the C updates. The return witness consumes the reconnected boundary stores and removed-node self-loop stores to construct the surviving DLL over prefix ++ suffix and a separate empty DLL rooted at the removed node. No annotation/spec repair or new helper declaration is required.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1, substitute nodes=prefix++linklist_node_pre::suffix and apply xizi_dll_split_at_node__dll_cut_split_reconnect, then unfold the one-field views into the generated stores. For return_wit_1, fold the rewired and self-loop stores into xizi_dll_next/xizi_dll_prev, apply xizi_dll_remove_result__dll_cut_split_reconnect with the generated removed-node non-null premise, then unfold the views for cancellation. The existing helper chain handles all empty/nonempty prefix and suffix boundary cases; add no group-local helper.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Treat removal as one ownership cut followed by two products: reconnect the prefix and suffix to represent prefix++suffix, while framing the removed node's two self-loop fields as an independent empty circular DLL. This preserves the public complete-sequence specification and the required reset semantics.
